newsitem.title: UK: Both Brent cargoes kept - traders.
newsitem.headline: Both Brent cargoes kept - traders.

text.p: LONDON, Jan 21, Reuter - Both cargoes of Brent crude oil nominated loading dates on Tuesday were kept voluntarily before the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The cargoes are due to load in the February 5-7 period and were kept by British Petroleum and U.S. refiner Koch, traders said.
A trading company is five o'clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and thus cannot be passed on as part of a chaine of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
